rejects.event: The Bordeaux proper population was recorded within its municipal territory.
rejects.quote: The city of Bordeaux proper had a population of 267,991 in 2023 within its small municipal territory of 49 km2 (19 sq mi), but together with its suburbs and exurbs the Bordeaux metropolitan area had a population of 1,426,278 (2023), the sixth-most populous in France after Paris, Lyon, Marseille, Lille, and Toulouse.
